narrative:
BA Revenue in the Q3 Forecast is GBP 15.2B, −1.9% against the GBP 15.5B Budget.

Transatlantic is the largest route network at GBP 5.4B (35% of group). Middle East is furthest ahead of plan (GBP -0.0B); Transatlantic is furthest behind (GBP -0.1B).

Key risk: the Transatlantic gap widens if the volume drivers on the Scenarios page move against plan.
